facts.business: Last Mile Enterprises Limited (formerly Trans Financial Resources Limited) is a listed company that has acquired 51% stakes in Agrimile Solutions Private Limited and Last Mile Energy Private Limited during the year, and has subsidiaries in technology, realty, and strategy sectors.
facts.related_party_note: There were no transactions with related parties which are not in the ordinary course of business and not on arm's length basis. There were no materially significant related party transactions that may have potential conflict with the interests of the company at large during the year.
